messages:
maria: Heads-up: we're putting tomorrow's multi-region cutover on hold. Found an edge-case in the quota-router that misroutes certain Dedicated tenant headers.
jon: Got it. Hold or rollback?
maria: Hold. We're going to patch and validate in canary first. No customer-facing impact detected yet.
sre-bot: incident-tracker created: INC-4521 (quota-router header mismatch).
leo: I can send a defensive shim that normalizes header order. Will open PR now.
jon: If shim fixes canary, plan to do staggered ramp: 10% -> 40% -> 100% with 45m soaks. Agree?
maria: Yes. Safety first. If any metric breaches, auto-rollback.
ops: What are thresholds? I want to update alerts and CS messaging.
maria: Thresholds: latency +25% sustained 10m, errors >0.4% 5m. Ops, please set the alerts and prepare rollback playbook.
leo: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/quota-router/pull/802 (hotfix shim). Running canary deploy now.
sre-bot: deploy-start maria/hotfix/shim -> infra-canary-a
product: I'll prep a short CS/Sales note: "Cutover delayed; investigating routing validation; ETA for decision 3 hours."
leo: Canary logs (excerpt): router.health=ok, routing.tests=998/1000 pass, failures related to header-order.
jon: Looks promising. If we hit >99% in canary over 30m, proceed with 10% ramp.
maria: Canary steady at 30m: pass 99.7%. Jon, kick the 10% ramp and post metrics here.
jon: Kicking ramp: infractl ramp --service quota-router --pct 10 --from canary-a
sre-bot: ramp-event id=rmp-9001 pct=10 status=started service=quota-router
jon: 10% ramp initial 10m metrics: latency +2%, errors 0.06%. No alerts.
ops: Updated CS channel and status page: "No customer impact; cutover deferred pending validation." Link: internal/INC-4521
maria: OK. If 1h soak stays green, proceed to 40%. We'll keep this thread as the single source of truth. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
